You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 5191fe2a29985f0689acce2f76fe5de32eecb610 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Lemberger <lembergerth@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2018 22:37:23 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Keep relative paths in spec and config dropdown

Fixes a bug introduced in 888867c that only showed the filename without
suffix.
---
 org.eclipse.cpacep/src/org/eclipse/cpacep/util/FileHandler.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/org.eclipse.cpacep/src/org/eclipse/cpacep/util/FileHandler.java b/org.eclipse.cpacep/src/org/eclipse/cpacep/util/FileHandler.java
index 4230f52..5277ace 100644
--- a/org.eclipse.cpacep/src/org/eclipse/cpacep/util/FileHandler.java
+++ b/org.eclipse.cpacep/src/org/eclipse/cpacep/util/FileHandler.java
@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@ public class FileHandler {
 			public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path path, BasicFileAttributes attrs) throws IOException {
 				Path fileName = path.getFileName();
 				if (pathMatcher.matches(fileName)) {
-					String tempPath = fileName.toString();
+					String tempPath = location.relativize(path).toString();
 
 					if (glob.contains(CPACEPConnector.SPEC_FILE_TYPE)) {
 						matchedList.add(tempPath.replace(CPACEPConnector.SPEC_FILE_TYPE, ""));
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a change made in commit 888867c, which modified the way file paths were handled. Instead of retaining the relative paths when matching files, it only displayed the filename without the file extension. This led to a loss of context about the location of the files within the directory structure, making it unclear which file was actually being referred to. The fix reinstates the relative path using `location.relativize(path).toString()` to ensure that the dropdown correctly shows the full context of where each file is located in relation to the base directory.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a change made in commit 888867c, which modified the way file paths were handled. Instead of retaining the relative paths when matching files, it only displayed the filename without the file extension. This led to a loss of context about the location of the files within the directory structure, making it unclear which file was actually being referred to. The fix reinstates the relative path using `location.relativize(path).toString()` to ensure that the dropdown correctly shows the full context of where each file is located in relation to the base directory.
